items.title: How Big Can Buddha Get?
items.task: Walk in before you look at a photo. How big is the Buddha, in your body: taller than Dad? Taller than the hall?
items.reveal: This is one of Japan’s great bronze Buddhas. Save the picture for after.

items.title: Why Build Something This Huge?

moreInfo.title: State and faith
moreInfo.text: A huge Buddha is prayer and politics: a ruler showing care and power. Confirm the Nara-period framing before live.
moreInfo.audioText: A hall this size is not only faith. It is also a state saying: we can build this. Check the emperor and the date before this page is live.

items.reveal: Religion and government sat in the same room here.
items.notes: Confirm Nara-period state and Buddhism framing for Tōdai-ji before live.

items.title: Enlightenment Hole
items.task: If the queue is kind, find the pillar hole. Only try if you want to, and if it is open.
items.notes: Do not surface if inaccessible. No pushing kids through.
